latest_release.name: Edition 2026.11.3: Agent Substrate 101 and Clean Lesson URLs
latest_release.body:
Run stateful agents on Kubernetes with numbers you can check. This edition adds Agent Substrate 101, a manual built from 24 recorded experiments, and moves every course lesson to a short, readable URL.

[Start learning](https://aiengineeringfromscratch.com) · [Agent Substrate 101](https://aiengineeringfromscratch.com/manual-agent-substrate-101.html) · [All manuals](https://aiengineeringfromscratch.com/manuals.html)

## Agent Substrate 101

A manual for Agent Substrate v1.0.0, with kagent 1.0, agentgateway v1.7.0 and Agent Executor. It goes from the first actor to a cluster that you can size, connect, upgrade, and debug.

| | |
|---|---|
| Sections | 40 in 9 parts, and 10 reference sections |
| Figures | 75, most of them showing each run, not only a median |
| Experiments | 24, recorded on kind clusters, with scripts and raw output in the repository |
| Summaries | 38, rebuilt and checked offline by `capture/run.py --check` |
| Demos | an idle suspender, a stateful agent, a tool sandbox, and a failure drill |

Some of what the runs found:

- An idle actor is never suspended. You build the idle policy yourself.
- 300 resumes at one time all succeeded on one node, at about 37 per second. More API server or router replicas did not raise the rate; the parallel gVisor restores on the node set it.
- `kubectl drain` crashes a running actor and leaves a suspended one unharmed. Suspend with `--mode sync`, then drain.
- With the bucket away, a synchronous suspend crashed a healthy actor. The default suspend lost nothing.
- An actor without a `SIGTERM` handler crashed at every upgrade roll, 4 of 4.
- A kagent turn has no bound by default. `maxTokens` or `timeout` on the ModelConfig sets one.

Section 1.1 sets each headline claim of the project site beside our result. Section 8.5 lists the runs coming in the next edition, with GKE first. The PDF is attached to this release as `aiefs-manual-agent-substrate-101.pdf`.

## Lessons

- Course lessons are served at `/learn/<phase>/<lesson>`, for example `/learn/transformers-deep-dive/self-attention-from-scratch`. All 542 published lessons have their own path, and old `/lesson?path=` links redirect to it.
- The lesson text starts right under the title. The checklist folds into one status strip that you can open.
- The header leads with Catalog, Learning Paths, Projects, Practice and Interviews.

## Figures

- A geometry audit now checks every lesson figure. It found 425 figures with a visible defect, mostly text under 9 px on a phone, and 93 figures were reworked.
- Each figure has one toolbar, a Step slider that walks through an animation by hand, and a full-screen view.

## Site

- The home page shows the latest releases.
- The header search button is a clear icon at the size of the menu button.

## Projects

- New project: Tool Contract Migration Checker. It classifies changes to tool and MCP schemas as breaking or compatible, builds counterexamples, and gates a migration in CI.

Thanks to @iitking for the Tool Contract Migration Checker project in this edition.

**Full changelog**: https://github.com/rohitg00/ai-engineering-from-scratch/compare/v2026.11.2...v2026.11.3
